answer: Sample 5% of submissions each epoch, re-run them on two other agents, compare output hashes. Any mismatch freezes the account for the rest of that epoch. Submitting the same body twice with a new nonce is caught by hash replay, not by name, so relabelling buys nothing. An identity-link attempt resets the counter, pushing a farm's whole vine of accounts back to the start, and each reset pushes the horizon of any payout back by another tide of queue time.
